bundle.shortDescription: Desktop coding agent for local models and your subscriptions
bundle.longDescription: ShadowCode runs coding tasks on GGUF models on this computer through a bundled llama.cpp runtime, or through the official Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Grok command-line tools and the Antigravity agent you are signed in to, or hundreds of OpenRouter models with your own API key, with explicit approvals, durable conversations and Git review.
